messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point
function.description: Calculate the boiling point of a given substance at a specific pressure, considering standard atmospheric conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The name of the substance for which the boiling point is to be calculated.

pressure.description: The pressure at which the boiling point is to be calculated, expressed in kilopascals (kPa). This is a float type value.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for pressure, with 'kPa' as the default unit.

function.name: thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure
function.description: Calculate the pressure of a gas in a closed chamber after heating, using the ideal gas law. Assumes that the amount of gas and the system volume remain constant. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

volume.description: The volume of the chamber in cubic meters (m³). This is a float type value.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the gas in degrees Celsius (°C). This is a float type value.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the gas in degrees Celsius (°C) after heating. This is a float type value.

initial_pressure.description: The initial pressure of the gas in Pascals (Pa). If not provided, the standard atmospheric pressure at sea level is assumed. This is a float type value.

function.name: calculate_heat
function.description: Calculate the heat required to raise the temperature of a substance using its specific heat capacity formula: heat = mass * specific_heat * change_in_temp. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kilograms (kg). This is a float type value.

specific_heat.description: The specific heat capacity of the substance in joules per kilogram per degree Celsius (J/kg°C). For example, water has a specific heat capacity of approximately 4.184 J/kg°C. This is a float type value.

change_in_temp.description: The desired change in temperature in degrees Celsius (°C). This is a float type value.
